## VI. CONCLUSION

We have presented cluster-based SDN architecture  CluFlow to manage communication flow in WSN, by controlling and of   cluster border nodes. CluFlow minimizes the number of border nodes and the communication overhead used for SDN control Based on the simulations and the experiments in a real network; we have demonstrated that   CluFlow   significantly   decreases the number of nodes and communication load needed by the SDN controller to control and monitor cluster-level communication flow compared with benchmark solutions.
